Page count is one factor; content preparation, templates, interaction, administration, integration and maintenance responsibilities all affect the work. This guide offers a checking method rather than a universal price.
内容由谁准备、整理和确认: Who prepares, organizes and approves content?
已有可用文案和清晰产品目录，与需要从头梳理内容，是不同的工作。比较方案时，确认是: Ready-to-use copy and a clear catalogue require different work from planning content from scratch. Check whether research, copy, translation, image preparation and initial content entry are included, and who approves each stage.
业务事实、参数和资质由谁核实？: Who verifies business facts, specifications and credentials?
文案与翻译包含几种语言、多少内容？: How many languages and how much copy are included?
第一批资料录入和后续更新是否分别约定？: Are initial content entry and future updates agreed separately?
页面数量与模板数量分别计算: Count templates separately from content pages
二十个产品详情可能共用一套模板，五个品牌展示页也可能各自需要定制布局。只看页数，: Twenty products may share one template, while five brand pages may each need a custom layout. List distinct templates, content entries and special interactions instead of judging the work by page count alone.
例如瑞和案例包含首页、企业介绍、产品中心、制造与质量、联系等不同的信息任务；创意: The Ruihe case includes home, company, products, manufacturing and quality, and contact, each serving a different task. A creative shop also needs ongoing content updates. A simple page-count table cannot describe both properly.
哪些页面共用结构，哪些需要独立设计？: Which pages share a structure, and which need individual design?
手机布局是同一套响应式实现，还是另有特殊交互？: Is mobile handled responsively, or does it need additional interaction?
确认轮次、范围调整与新增页面如何处理？: How are review rounds, scope changes and extra pages handled?
定制视觉与现有模板的边界: Where does template adaptation end and custom design begin?
现有模板可以减少设计工作，但仍需检查是否适合内容、移动布局和维护。定制设计应说明: An existing template can reduce design work, but it still needs checking against content, mobile layout and maintenance. Custom work should define pages, states and implementation scope, not just a homepage picture.
参考网站可以用来沟通阅读节奏或交互方式，不能替代对自身受众、素材与业务信息的整理: References help discuss reading rhythm and interaction. They cannot replace your own audience, assets and business information. Agree responsibility for image, font and third-party component licences too.
内容管理、会员、支付、预约和外部系统联调的复杂度不同。每一项都需要有字段、角色、: Content management, memberships, payments, bookings and external integrations differ greatly. Each needs fields, roles, states and failure handling. “Includes a backend” is too vague to establish what can be edited.
谁能查看、编辑、删除和发布哪些内容？: Who can view, edit, delete and publish each type of content?
第三方账号、接口额度和服务费用由谁提供？: Who provides third-party accounts, API allowances and service fees?
表单失败、上传中断或接口不可用时怎样处理？: What happens if a form fails, an upload stops or an API is unavailable?
把一次开发费用和持续费用分开看。域名、服务器、存储与第三方服务可能需要续费；后续: Separate development fees from recurring costs. Domains, hosting, storage and external services may renew. Assign responsibility for content changes, updates, backups and faults.
源码交付、环境说明和数据库备份不能只口头说“后面给”。把可交接的内容、账号归属与: Put source-code delivery, runtime notes and database backups in the written checklist, together with account ownership and acceptance criteria, so a new maintainer can continue the work.

收录与排名还受内容、竞争和其他因素影响。报价若包含推广或持续内容工作，应分别说明: Indexing and rankings also depend on content, competition and other factors. If a quote includes promotion or ongoing content work, define outputs and measurement separately. Keywords or a framework alone do not prove a promised position.
先用 Search Console 查看实际收录、展示、点击和查询词。: Use Search Console to check actual indexing, impressions, clicks and queries.

4. 提前确认源码、账号和数据怎样交接: 4. Agree on source code, accounts and data handover

列清一次开发费用与后续持续费用。: Separate development costs from recurring expenses.
